new_categories.label: terminal_dry_bulk_storage_reclaim_service_readiness
new_categories.memory: Terminal dry-bulk storage/reclaim assurance is a delivered operating service-state distinct from long-horizon yard/land capacity and from berth-side transfer-equipment/path readiness.

new_categories.label: storage_zone_availability
new_categories.memory: A bounded stockyard, silo or storage-zone availability state can be represented without retaining exact capacity, dimensions, stockpile geometry or identifiers.

new_categories.label: stockyard_silo_scope_confidence
new_categories.memory: Storage/reclaim assurance can be localized to a bounded yard, silo, bin, zone, parcel or operation scope without retaining exact terminal layout or commercial identifiers.

new_categories.label: cargo_location_mapping_confidence
new_categories.memory: Confidence that dry-bulk cargo remains associated with the intended bounded storage location can be represented without retaining exact stockpile coordinates, silo numbers or records.

new_categories.label: storage_segregation_condition_confidence
new_categories.memory: A non-specific physical segregation/condition confidence can be retained for stored dry-bulk cargo without storing exact commodity, blend, contamination or quality specifications.

new_categories.label: reclaim_feed_path_readiness
new_categories.memory: Reclaim/feed path readiness can be represented separately from storage-zone availability and from downstream berth-transfer-path readiness without retaining exact equipment or routing.

new_categories.label: storage_to_reclaim_continuity_confidence
new_categories.memory: Storage and reclaim components can each appear available while the intended end-to-end feed path is not continuous; continuity confidence is therefore a distinct structural state.

new_categories.label: storage_reclaim_monitoring_indication_confidence
new_categories.memory: Monitoring or indication confidence can be separated from physical storage/reclaim readiness without retaining exact sensors, level devices, controls, alarms or values.

new_categories.label: storage_reclaim_support_dependency_confidence
new_categories.memory: Power, control, utility, access, maintenance or other support dependencies can degrade separately from the delivered storage/reclaim service without retaining exact dependency topology.

new_categories.label: stored_cargo_availability_not_berth_feed_equivalence
new_categories.memory: Cargo being present in a terminal storage area is not equivalent to being reclaimable and feed-ready for the intended berth/cargo operation.

new_categories.label: storage_reclaim_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: Storage/reclaim assurance can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-restoration and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_storage_reclaim_restriction_downstream_not_root_cause
new_categories.memory: Restrictions can attach to storage zone, location mapping, segregation/condition, reclaim path, monitoring or support state, while berth-feed loss, throughput uncertainty, rework or schedule effects do not prove the root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_storage_reclaim_restoration
new_categories.memory: Storage-zone recovery, cargo-location confirmation, segregation/condition verification, reclaim-path recovery, monitoring return, berth-feed confidence and restriction release can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: operating_storage_readiness_vs_terminal_land_yard_capacity
useful_refinements.memory: P021 yard/land capacity is a long-horizon infrastructure pool; P130 distinguishes current bounded stockyard/silo/storage-zone operating readiness and reclaimability.

useful_refinements.label: terminal_storage_location_vs_shipboard_identity_traceability
useful_refinements.memory: P125 shipboard lot/parcel/stowage-zone traceability does not establish shore stockyard/silo storage-location or reclaim-feed assurance.

useful_refinements.label: storage_reclaim_path_vs_berth_transfer_path
useful_refinements.memory: P129 berth-side conveyor/shiploader/unloader transfer path is downstream of, and distinct from, terminal storage/reclaim/feed readiness.

useful_refinements.label: stored_cargo_segregation_vs_broad_terminal_handling
useful_refinements.memory: P014 broad terminal handling and parcel segregation establish physical execution concepts but not a dedicated storage-zone/reclaim service-state.

duplicates.label: generic_location_scope_monitoring_support_lifecycle
duplicates.memory: Generic bounded scope, monitoring, support dependency, degradation and restoration mechanics repeat prior assurance/service families.

duplicates.label: generic_path_continuity_restriction_downstream_separation
duplicates.memory: Generic path continuity, restriction/isolation, downstream-effect separation and multi-stage restoration are already campaign-wide.

stop_reason: The bounded terminal dry-bulk storage/reclaim questions are answered; further recall trends toward exact stockpile/silo capacities, equipment, routes, blend/quality specifications, procedures, providers or incidents that are deferred to Evidence.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive terminal dry-bulk storage/reclaim orientation and source-discovery output; not stockpiling, reclaiming, blending, routing, sampling, equipment-operation, maintenance or emergency guidance and not proof of any exact capacity, location, equipment, route, blend, quality, procedure, provider, incident or current-readiness fact.
